name: mms_send
description: Send an MMS attachment (audio, image, or video) to a phone number on rooted Android/Termux. Posts directly to the AT&T MMSC — fully headless, no screen or Google Messages required. Returns structured JSON when called with --json.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

file.description: Absolute path to the file to send. Supported: mp3, m4a, ogg, aac, wav, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp4, 3gp, vcf, txt.

mime.description: MIME type override. Auto-detected from file extension if omitted.

file.description: Path of the file that was sent.

txn_id.description: WAP transaction ID embedded in the PDU.

http_status.description: HTTP status line returned by MMSC.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code (present only when status=error).
